notablePrerequisites: Channeler Initiate has at least four counters on it.
description:
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from Channeler Initiate.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Channeler Initiate, adding {C}{C}.
Channeler Initiate dies, triggering Felisa, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Inkling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 1, causing you to mill three cards and return Channeler Initiate from your graveyard to the battlefield with three -1/-1 counters and a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat.
